evidence_boundary.relation_edge_set: AG3 instantiated nine predeclared relation-edge objects

status_semantics.SUPPORTED: The bounded admitted evidence directly supports the proposition represented by the edge at the named capture coordinate, without requiring an unadmitted bridge.
status_semantics.CONTRADICTED: The bounded admitted evidence directly conflicts with the proposition represented by the edge.
status_semantics.UNRESOLVED: The bounded admitted evidence contains relevant ambiguity or conflict that prevents either support or contradiction.
status_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: A required endpoint, source surface, or proposition-level evidence is absent from the admitted evidence boundary; absence is not contradiction.
status_semantics.NOT_EVALUATED: The edge was not evaluated under this AG4 execution.
status_semantics.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The proposition lies outside the AG0-bounded question.

evaluations.basis: AG1 bound the exact uploaded artifact by filename, byte length, and locally computed SHA-256. AG2 observed release object 301345178 for tag v0.22.1, whose release body listed the selected filename, and GitHub release-asset object 381438738 reported the same filename, byte length, and SHA-256. No additional provenance or authorization meaning is imported.
non_claims: This does not establish build provenance.
This does not establish attestation validity.
This does not establish organizational approval or deployment authorization.

evaluations.basis: AG2 observed the checksum asset metadata and release linkage, but did not capture the 115-byte checksum-file content. The GitHub-reported digest of the checksum-file object identifies that checksum file itself and is not substituted for the checksum assertion contained inside it.
non_claims: The published checksum assertion is not contradicted.
The source-reported digest field for release asset 381438738 is not silently promoted into the separately instantiated checksum-assertion edge.

evaluations.basis: The release body stated that release artifacts have GitHub Artifact Attestations and the observed workflow text contained an attest-build-provenance step, but AG2 captured no attestation bundle or decoded predicate binding the exact CAPTURE_001 artifact digest as an attestation subject.
non_claims: Workflow attestation configuration is not equivalent to a captured attestation subject binding.

evaluations.basis: No attestation bundle or decoded predicate was admitted. The repository hosting the release and workflow is observed as googleworkspace/cli, but that observation cannot substitute for an attestation-to-repository claim that was not captured.
non_claims: The repository relation is not contradicted.
Repository adjacency does not establish attestation provenance.

evaluations.basis: AG2 observed tag v0.22.1, source commit 45ca45bfd418db07b02995e8510dd18ac45cb3a6, the release workflow at that commit, and a successful release run at that head SHA. No captured attestation predicate binds an attestation object to that commit.
non_claims: The commit relation is not contradicted.
A successful release run at the commit does not itself establish an attestation-to-commit edge.

evaluations.basis: AG2 observed tag v0.22.1 resolving to commit 45ca45bfd418db07b02995e8510dd18ac45cb3a6, observed .github/workflows/release.yml at that exact commit, and observed release workflow run 23554953556 reporting the same workflow path and head SHA. This supports the bounded commit-to-workflow-reference relation only.
non_claims: This does not establish that the workflow produced the exact public release artifact.
This does not establish attestation validity or signer authority.

evaluations.basis: AG2 did not capture an attestation predicate identifying a claimed issuer in the edge's required sense, and no independent authority instrument was admitted that could establish the issuer's authority for the represented claim.
non_claims: No claim is made that the observed GitHub Actions actor lacked authority.
Actor identity, workflow permission, and issuer authority remain distinct.

evaluations.basis: AG0 required status to remain coordinate-bound, AG2 established the CAPTURE_001 observation window, and AG3 bound the evaluated edge set to CAPTURE_001. AG4 therefore supports only that the standing assigned in this evaluation is applicable to the named CAPTURE_001 evidence/record coordinate. It does not establish persistence before or after that coordinate.
non_claims: No external relation is asserted to have remained continuously valid across an unobserved interval.
Current standing is not inherited backward or forward in time.

evaluations.basis: The AG2 source set contains release, tag, commit, and workflow-run observations but no independently bounded source establishing whether any evaluated relation had been superseded at CAPTURE_001. Release immutability and absence of an observed supersession event are not treated as proof of non-supersession.

admitted: three SUPPORTED statuses with explicit scope qualifiers
six INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE statuses with explicit missingness bases
CAPTURE_001 coordinate binding for all AG4 results
not_admitted: provenance beyond the supported edge scopes
supersession or non-supersession standing beyond admitted evidence
